oxford_mcf.required: First-class or strong upper-second degree in mathematics/related discipline; probability, statistics, ODE/PDE, linear algebra and analysis, especially real analysis; sufficient maths for non-mathematics graduates.
oxford_mcf.taught_language: C++ practical assessments; prior C++ not presented as a separately stated compulsory admissions qualification.

epfl_mfe.required: Economics bachelor eligible for dossier evaluation; analysis, linear algebra, calculus, statistics/probability and command of one programming/interpreted language.
epfl_mfe.project_does_not_replace: Excellent academic records and programme admissions evaluation.

uzh_eth_qf.required: Prior multivariate calculus/linear algebra and real-analysis courses including sequential/topological compactness; substantial probability/statistics preparation.
uzh_eth_qf.recommended: Lebesgue/Radon–Nikodym exposure advantageous; stochastic calculus strongly recommended; significant familiarity with Jacod–Protter and Paolella.

st_gallen_miqef.formal_credit_rule: Similar economics degree: 60 ECTS economics/maths/statistics/computer science, including 30 economics and six statistics; bachelor thesis and extra credits excluded from similarity.
st_gallen_miqef.project_role: Evidence for analytical writing and sustained interest; cannot replace credits.
st_gallen_miqef.writing_sample: At least 3,000 words/completed bachelor thesis or alternative economics-related essay up to 20 pages; authorship declaration. Current quantum pricing paper is not automatically an admissible economics writing sample.

imperial_math_finance.advertised_minimum: 2:1 in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics or physics.

imperial_rmfe.advertised_minimum: 2:1 highly quantitative degree, including economics; probability, calculus, matrix algebra and real analysis.
imperial_rmfe.taught_language: Python primary; optional Computational Finance with C++.

lse_financial_mathematics.advertised_minimum: 2:1 mathematically based or suitable science/engineering/social-science degree with excellent mathematics.
lse_financial_mathematics.pre_session: MA400 compulsory; advanced measure/stochastic material is partly taught rather than every item being a universal formal entry rule.

bocconi_mafinrisk.route: Separate 12-month specialised Master of Quantitative Finance and Risk Management; economics/finance and quantitative undergraduate backgrounds eligible, with selection/test/dossier.

princeton_mfin.degree_structure: Five core and eleven electives; pre-approved catalogue not guaranteed annual timetable.

columbia_msfe.preparation_expectation: Quantitative backgrounds including economics; multivariable calculus, linear algebra, probability/statistics and coding, differential equations advantageous; Python mastery emphasised for MSFE.
